description: Precision voltage source and adder, setting a voltage by octave and semitone for tuning and transposition

params.text: Adds a whole number of volts, 0 to 10, each step one octave at a volt per octave
Picks the span of the voltage set by hand: 0-10V, or -5V to 5V, which takes 5V off the octave setting
Adds a twelfth of a volt per step, one semitone at a time from C up to B

inputs.text: A voltage added to the one set by the two knobs

outputs.text: The voltage set by the octave and semitone knobs, with anything patched into the sum input added to it
